maintenance_led.reason: Commercial roofing (CCM, larger segment) is mostly reroofing and replacement of existing roofs; CWT is the smaller segment.

publicly_funded.reason: Roofing, insulation and weatherproofing products are bought by private commercial and residential building owners via contractors and distributors.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling roofing and building envelope products; it has made acquisitions but has also divested other businesses.

mission_critical.reason: Roofing membranes, insulation and sealants can be switched between suppliers fairly easily, though warranted systems add some friction.

notes: Reroofing share is from general knowledge, not the website text; mission-critical is borderline.
